ending.title: The Exit
ending.body: The fail-safe takes them out days before the garage work began — 'we could be the ones who are not'. Aaron's final call is from a world we cannot date.

run2.label: the full-day doubles — leave ~noon, wake earlier

run3.label: the fail-safe exit — out days earlier

legend: Channel grammar: one world-line, the box rides INSIDE it — out late, in earlier. No lanes are added by a box run.
Drawn once, honestly simplified: the film's copies-on-copies (Granger, the phone call, which Aaron narrates) are never resolvable on any chart.
The fail-safe exit arc is the film's ending: two men walk out of their own history.

nodes.title: The World — One Line
nodes.body: The garage: four engineers build weevil traps, then the box — the object that loops its inside.
